speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Fishing is deeply tied to the cultural identity and livelihood of Arcadian fishers.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Our communities depend on bottom-trawling and have few economic alternatives.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The wind park's underwater structures make these fishing grounds unsuitable for bottom-trawling.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Other suitable fishing grounds are too far from the coast, and we do not have the means to adapt our techniques.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The project negatively impacts SDGs 1, 2 and 8, and threatens our rights to work and to an adequate standard of living.
